name: Energoinstal S.A.
summary: Energoinstal S.A. is a Polish enterprise with an international presence, primarily engaged in the fabrication, distribution, and commissioning of power generation boilers. Beyond industrial and energy-sector boilers, their extensive product portfolio encompasses a range of essential components, including oil and gas combustion systems, pressure regulation and metering units for gas and oil, specialized finned and cladded tubes, pressure vessels, and structural steel elements. They also provide heat pipeline parts, ventilation and dust extraction ductwork complete with flaps, and other specialized industrial equipment tailored to unique requirements. Energoinstal offers a comprehensive suite of services, from the assembly, upkeep, and repair of diverse boiler types – including those for energy, industrial steam, water, biofuels, waste treatment, oil/gas-fired, heat recovery steam generators, and coal-fired units – to their auxiliary components. Their expertise extends to broader infrastructure, covering boiler houses, support structures for boilers and industrial buildings, environmental protection systems, heat pipelines, and various utility networks such as central heating, water and sewage, process heat, chilled water, ventilation, air conditioning, and dedusting systems. Additionally, they provide stainless steel products and systems for the food, chemical, and construction industries, alongside thermal insulation solutions. The company further provides engineering and project management services, encompassing the design and oversight of steel structures, power generation apparatus, and technological installations. As a general contractor, they manage the construction of entire industrial facilities and combined heat and power (CHP) plants. Energoinstal is also active in research and development, particularly in material science, welding techniques, and the heat treatment of materials. They conduct comprehensive testing of metal properties and welded joints. Additionally, Energoinstal delivers diverse training programs for corporate clients, public institutions, educational facilities, and individuals, including specialized vocational training for welders. The firm distinguishes itself with advanced manufacturing technologies, such as hybrid welding for sheet pile panels, laser welding for finned tubes, and robotic systems for precision laser cutting. Energoinstal caters to clients within the energy and construction sectors, along with the electrical machinery markets. Established in 1949 and headquartered in Katowice, Poland, Energoinstal S.A. operates as a subsidiary of W.A.M. Sp. z o.o.
